name: EmitPathFollowerWheelParticles
evidence: fades the dust object at +0xB14 and, per wheel slot (+0x6B0), turns each accumulated emit count of one into particle records spawned at the wheel's position with a random tilt and its velocity, sent to the slot-0x7C emitters (+0xAFC or +0xB18, +0xB1C)

name: CountDownPathFollowerLap
evidence: stores the game time at +0x854, counts the laps at +0x858 down by one and calls slot 6 of the object at +0xB14 when there is one

name: RecordPathFollowerProgress
evidence: passes a 0..1 fraction from the lap index at +0xB00 to func_00151E20 on D_00261EF0, then sets every bit from 0 up to the index +0xB0C minus +0xB08 in the current entry's bit set at +0x74, counting each newly set bit at +0x70

name: AdvancePathFollowerEntry
evidence: original assembly: moves the current entry (+0xAF8) along the entry list (first at +0xAF4, count at +0x870), counts the lap at +0xB00 from +0xB04, sets the state walker's target (GetStateWalkerTargetKey, SetStateWalkerTarget), resets the scatter levels and records the progress (RecordPathFollowerProgress); UpdatePathFollower calls it

name: UpdatePathFollowerSound
evidence: original assembly: eases the value at 0xBA0 toward the turn at 0x698 (ApproachValueWithRamp) and from it and the speed (+0x150) sets the pitch and volume of the follower's sound record (SetSoundRecordPitch, SetSoundRecordVolume); UpdatePathFollower calls it
